lines.speaker: Draconia Malfoy
lines.text: The ink moves without a wand, forming words I did not write. The message reads Polyjuice batch ready midnight Astronomy Tower signed with a single initial.
lines.emotion: stunned disbelief sharpening into cold resolve
lines.expression: eyes locked on the parchment, breath barely moving, fingers tightening around the cloak's edge

lines.speaker: Draconia Malfoy
lines.text: Pansy's threat bought me hours, but this note buys me a target. I will be in that tower before the clock strikes twelve.
lines.emotion: quiet fury hardening into deliberate purpose
lines.expression: jaw sets, parchment crushed into a fist, body turning toward the window
